text: The future of AI is a topic that many people discuss today. Most AI systems we use now are designed for specific tasks, but researchers are working on general AI, also called AGI. AGI would be able to understand and learn any task like a human. This could bring great benefits, such as better healthcare and smarter education. However, there are also risks, including job losses and safety concerns. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive. Some predict it within ten years, while others believe it is much further away. Because of this uncertainty, governments and scientists are calling for careful research and clear rules to make sure AI develops safely.
